verdict.rationale: Working Copy's manual documents long-tapping a commit to Delete Commit (rewriting the branch without it), Edit Message, or Squash a commit with its child. It also supports undoing unpushed commits and amending the latest commit, which together cover most interactive history rewriting. Missing for 10: reordering commits, editing the content of arbitrary past commits (only messages are documented), independent or hands-on corroboration.
